function.name: onefichier_ls
function.description: A 1fichier folder: its sub folders, then its files newest first, one line each: date, size in bytes, download link, file name. The FTP folder, where FTP uploads land once processed, by default. One listing per folder every 30 seconds, the API bans after repeated errors.

folder_id.title: Folder id, 0 for the root, the FTP folder by default

function.name: onefichier_info
function.description: Details of one 1fichier link: name, size, date, folder, path, type, checksum, protections.

url.title: Download link, https://1fichier.com/? followed by 5 to 20 lowercase letters and digits

function.name: onefichier_account
function.description: Plan, storage use and FTP settings of the 1fichier account (ftp_did is the FTP folder, ftp_mode 0 processes uploads automatically). One call every 5 minutes.

function.name: onefichier_mv
function.description: Move one or more 1fichier files to a folder (0 for the root), renaming the file when only one is moved. A move can fail half way: the result then lists the links that did move.

urls.title: Download links, https://1fichier.com/? followed by 5 to 20 lowercase letters and digits

folder_id.title: Destination folder id, 0 for the root

rename.title: New file name, single file only

function.name: onefichier_rm
function.description: Delete one or more 1fichier files. They go to the 1fichier trash and can be restored for 30 days. A delete can fail half way: the result then lists the links that were deleted.

urls.title: Download links, https://1fichier.com/? followed by 5 to 20 lowercase letters and digits

function.name: onefichier_mkdir
function.description: Create a 1fichier folder, at the root or inside folder_id.

folder_id.title: Parent folder id, the root by default
